definitions.gloss: ambition, desire to improve oneself, aspiration
definitions.explanation: The inner drive to better oneself, develop skills, or advance in life. A positive character trait involving the motivation to keep growing and not become complacent.

examples.japanese: {向上心|こうじょうしん}のある{人|ひと}は{成長|せいちょう}が{早|はや}い。
examples.english: People with a desire to improve grow quickly.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{向上心|こうじょうしん}が{強|つよ}く、{常|つね}に{新|あたら}しいことに{挑戦|ちょうせん}している。
examples.english: She has a strong drive to improve and is always taking on new challenges.

examples.japanese: {向上心|こうじょうしん}を{持|も}ち{続|つづ}けることが{仕事|しごと}でもプライベートでも{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to keep your desire to improve alive, both at work and in your personal life.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {向上心|こうじょうしん}がある (have ambition/drive)
- {向上心|こうじょうしん}が{強|つよ}い (have a strong desire to improve)
- {向上心|こうじょうしん}を{持|も}つ (have aspirations)
- {向上心|こうじょうしん}に{欠|か}ける (lack ambition)

A compound of {向上|こうじょう} (improvement, advancement) and {心|しん} (mind, spirit). Frequently appears in self-help books, job interviews, and discussions about personal development. Always carries a positive connotation.
